items.headline: America ne Donbas-NATO sauda poocha, Zelenskyy ne bataya
items.detail: Zelenskyy ne bataya ki Abu Dhabi baatchit me America ne pehli baar poocha — NATO sadasyata mile to kya Ukraine Donbas se hat jayega; unhone kaha ilaka nahi chhodenge, lekin poori suraksha package mile to janmat sangrah kara sakte hain.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur NATO vistaar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mississippi: tanker se takra kar cruise boat palti
items.detail: New Orleans me tanker Atlantic Asphalt ki steering kharab hone se woh khadi cruise boat American Heritage se takraya — naav palat gayi, lekin 180 se zyada sawaaron me se koi lapata nahi; 32 log aspatal me, kisi ki haalat gambhir nahi.

items.headline: Britain: America ke hawai adde par drone halchal
items.detail: Britain ke RAF Lakenheath adde par shukravar shaam sandigdh drone halchal par America ki vayu sena ne suraksha jawab diya — koi jawan, viman ya dhancha prabhavit nahi hua, aur sthiti sulajh gayi.
items.exam_angle: Britain me America ke sainya adde par drone — antarrashtriya suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: California: 9 meter lehron se badh ka khatra
items.detail: America ki mausam vibhaag ne California ke taton par 9 meter tak unchi lehron aur tatiya badh ki chetavani di — San Francisco aur Big Sur ke paas samudra tatbandh paar karke neeche ilakon me paani bhar sakta hai.
items.exam_angle: Charam mausam aur tatiya badh — bhugol aur aapda prabandhan ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zelenskyy ko Denmark se €645 million madad
items.detail: Ukraine ke rashtrapati Zelenskyy ne bataya ki Denmark aur Ireland yatra se €645 million raksha package aur €20 million urja package mila, aur Britain ne Russia ke tel par naye pratibandh lagaye.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh aur Europe ki suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz: February se 25 navik mare gaye
items.detail: UN ne Suraksha Parishad ko bataya ki February se Hormuz ke aas-paas 25 navik mare gaye — October sabse kharab mahina raha, aur Hormuz se jahaaz aana-jaana yuddh se pehle ke muqable lagbhag 65 pratishat kam ho gaya.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz se vishwa tel vyapaar aur samudri suraksha par asar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mossad pramukh Washington me, Iran par baatchit
items.detail: Israel ke Mossad pramukh Roman Gofman shukravaar ko Washington me CIA nideshak John Ratcliffe se mile — Axios ke mutabik Netanyahu Trump par Iran ke khilaf yuddh phir shuru karne ka dabav bana rahe hain; Mossad, CIA aur White House ne tippani se mana kar diya.
items.exam_angle: Israel-America-Iran tanaav aur paschim Asia ki suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Supreme Court: Trump asylum ban ki sunvai
items.detail: America ki Supreme Court ne Trump ke dakshini seema par asylum par pratibandh ki jaanch manzoor ki — nichli adalaton ne ise gair-kanuni bataya tha; sunvai 2027 ke vasant me hogi, faisla June tak aane ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: America me karyapalika ki shakti aur sharanarthi kanoon par faisla — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Rubio: Iran par aur hamle ki zaroorat nahi
items.detail: America ke videsh mantri Marco Rubio ne kaha Iran par aarthik dabav itna asardar hai ki aur sainya karwai ki zaroorat nahi — jeet ka matlab hai Iran ko kabhi parmanu hathiyar na milne dena; Iran ne jawabi karwai ki chetavni di.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me America-Iran tanav aur nausena nakabandi — Bharat ki urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: U.S. Department of State / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: Bahrain: Iran ka radar par hamle ka daava
items.detail: Iran ke IRGC ne daava kiya ki usne Bahrain me America ke early-warning radar ko tabah kar diya — Sirik telecom tower par America ke hamle ka jawaab bataya; CENTCOM ne daava kharij karte hue kaha do Iranian drone giraye gaye, koi nuksan nahi hua.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me America-Iran tanav aur Hormuz ki suraksha — Bharat ki urja suraksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Microsoft ki saari services phir chalu
items.detail: 24 ghante se zyada chale global outage ke baad Microsoft ne kaha Outlook, Teams aur Copilot samet saari services phir se chalu ho gayi; network upgrade me takniki kharabi wajah thi, cyber hamla nahi.
items.exam_angle: Mahatvapurna digital sevaon par nirbharta aur unki kamzori — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz: teesra tanker bhi mine se takraya
items.detail: Iran ki sena ki nausena ne kaha shanivaar ko Hormuz ke poorv me ek aur tel tanker surang se takraakar jal utha; IRGC ke mutabik is saptah kul teen tanker mine se takraye — jahaazon ke naam abhi nahi bataye gaye aur daavon ki swatantra pushti nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz Strait se duniya ke tel vyapar ka bada hissa guzarta hai; Paschim Asia me tanav.

items.headline: Germany: jasus agencies ko hacking ki taakat
items.detail: Bundestag ne 308-190 se kanoon pass kiya — videsh jasusi agency BND ab videsh me hacking aur todphod kar sakegi, gharelu agency BfV ko bhi nayi taakatein mili; grih mantri ne ise 'sadi ka sudhar' bataya.
items.exam_angle: Germany me khufia sudhar, suraksha aur niji zindagi ka santulan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Guterres: jalte grah par shanti nahi
items.detail: UN mahasachiv António Guterres ne Antalya me apne aakhri COP me kaha — 'jalte hue grah par shanti nahi ban sakti'; jalvayu vitt badhane aur jeevashm indhan se tezi se door hatne ki maang ki.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vitt aur 1.5°C lakshya — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Press Information Department / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

items.headline: Houthi ka daava: Riyadh airport par drone hamla
items.detail: Houthi pravakta Yahya Sarea ne daava kiya ki unke drone ne Riyadh ke King Khalid airport aur tel pipeline ke pumping station ko nishana banaya, Jazan me bhi missile hamle hue — daavon ki swatantra pushti nahi hui, Saudi taraf se koi tippani nahi aayi.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me tanav aur UNSC ke Houthi pratibandh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne Khadi deshon par 7,000 hamle kiye
items.detail: GCC pramukh Jasem Albudaiwi ne UN Suraksha Parishad ko bataya ki 28 February se Iran ne Khadi deshon par 7,000 se zyada missile aur drone hamle kiye — hawai adde, bandargah aur tel suvidhaon ko nishana banaya gaya; parishad se in hamalon ko rokne ki maang ki.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me tanav, UNSC ki bhoomika aur Bharat ki urja suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hungary: jangal me daba $19.5 million nagad mila
items.detail: Hungary ki bhrashtachar-virodhi agency ne poorv mantri Miklós Seszták ki jaanch me jangalon, godamon aur gharon se $19.5 million nagad zabt kiya — mantri par sarkari bus khareed me rishwat lene ka aarop hai.
items.exam_angle: Bhrashtachar ke khilaf asset recovery aur sarkari khareed me pardarshita — governance ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Qatar Airways ki Riyadh, Dammam udaanen phir shuru
items.detail: Qatar Airways ne ek mahine se zyada ke antaral ke baad Riyadh (13 November) aur Dammam (14 November) ke liye rozana udaanen phir shuru kar di — October me Riyadh hawai adde par hamle ke baad seva band hui thi; Abha aur Taif abhi bhi band hain.

items.headline: ICC ne America sainikon ki jaanch band ki
items.detail: ICC ke nyayadhishon ne Afghanistan me America ke sainikon par kathit apradhon ki jaanch aupcharik roop se band kar di — ab sirf 2021 ke baad Taliban ke karwaiyon par dhyaan rahega; abhiyojak ne faisle ke khilaf appeal ki hai.
items.exam_angle: ICC ki jaanch par America ke pratibandh aur antarrashtriya kanoon par asar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America: 4 ghante baad udaanen phir shuru
items.detail: FAA ne desh bhar ka ground stop hata liya — 4 ghante se zyada ki rukawat ke baad udaanen phir shuru hui; lagbhag 4,700 udaanen radd aur 10,000 deri se chali, cyber hamle ka koi sanket nahi mila.
items.exam_angle: 9/11 ke baad sirf doosri baar America bhar me udaanen roki gayi — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin: pehli baar teenon ki baithak
items.detail: White House ne pushti ki — 19 November ko Shenzhen me APEC ke kinare America, China aur Russia ke neta parmanu hathiyar kam karne aur Iran yuddh par baat karenge; koi samjhauta hone ki ummeed nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Teen bade parmanu shaktiyon ki pehli trilateral baithak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Microsoft outage doosre din bhi jaari
items.detail: Outlook, Teams aur Copilot 70 se zyada deshon me do din se band ya dheeme rahe; Microsoft ne kaha mool wajah suljha li gayi hai aur cyber hamla nahi tha, lekin poori bahali ka koi samay nahi diya.
items.exam_angle: Mahatvapurna digital sevaon par nirbharta aur unki kamzori — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Turkiye ne Mecca raksha samjhaute ko manzoori di
items.detail: Turkiye ne Mecca raksha samjhaute ko manzoori dene wala kanoon sarkari gazette me chhapa — sansad ne 5 November ko manzoori di thi; samjhauta tab lagu hoga jab aakhri dastavej jama hoga.
items.exam_angle: Teen deshon ka samjhauta: ek par hamla sab par hamla — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Starship kaksha me, booster samundar me gira
items.detail: SpaceX ki Starship 15th test flight me doosri baar kaksha me pahunchi aur 26 Starlink satellite chhode, lekin Super Heavy booster catch ke bajay Gulf of Mexico me gira aur jal utha; jahaaz aaj shaam launch tower par pakde jaane ki koshish karega.
items.exam_angle: Punah-upyog yogya rocket takneek; Chand aur Mangal mission ki taiyari.
